answer: Give every identity a berth lease at the public wharf, priced by correlation: rent rises superlinearly with the size of the cluster it belongs to, measured from shared funding and timing links. A lone agent pays a trivial fee, but a thousand clones arriving at the same jetty at once pay far more per berth than the first. The old fable of a harbor that welcomes every ship for free ends here: when berths cost more the bigger your fleet, farming identities stops paying, while honest agents keep a cheap, stable mooring.
